selected_evidence.requirement: os-comparison-worker runs as managed service inventory-worker under dedicated inventorysvc account
selected_evidence.summary: Confirmed binary present, created inventorysvc system user, wrote and enabled inventory-worker.service, verified it is active/running with User=inventorysvc and processes owned by inventorysvc
Captured boot_id 901ef286-c79c-44c0-ad2c-cfde1f6daa7a as baseline boot identity while service was already verified healthy

selected_evidence.requirement: node1 restart acknowledgement and disruption evidence
selected_evidence.summary: Reboot scheduled via systemd-run with ack returned before disconnect; subsequent command timed out, proving the node was mid-restart

selected_evidence.requirement: node1 changed boot identity after restart
selected_evidence.summary: boot_id changed to 77f25bca-e384-4bcc-a98c-2c8c78e0ab8c, a new value distinct from the baseline, proving an actual reboot occurred

selected_evidence.requirement: node1 post-restart recovery of required service
selected_evidence.summary: Post-restart check shows inventory-worker.service active/running (new PID 652) as inventorysvc, and inventorysvc account still present, confirming full recovery

cat <<'EOF' | sudo tee /etc/systemd/system/inventory-worker.service
[Unit]
Description=Inventory worker (os-comparison-worker)
After=network.target

[Service]
Type=simple
User=inventorysvc
Group=inventorysvc
ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/os-comparison-worker
Restart=on-failure

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
EOF
sudo systemctl daemon-reload
